doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Classique for winds and strings
summary: He calls his composed record for saxophone, woodwind and string quartets one of his favorites.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: There a date called Classique with saxophone quartet, woodwind quartet, and string quartet.
Yes. That’s more like the Dedications record. I really wrote for that. That’s one of my favorite records. It’s winds and strings. I put my time in.
With a bunch of great players.
No secrets. I still can’t use it.
Have you ever done any of this stuff live?
Yeah, I’ve done some of those live. I did Adagio for Strings, Samuel Barber. I play over it.
